news.title: 'Unbelievable' Flagg finishes with 43 points as Mavericks outlast Pacers
news.text: Dallas star Cooper Flagg, 19, authored one of the finest efforts of his young career on Monday night, stuffing the box score with 43 points, 10 rebounds, six assists, three steals and a block in the Dallas Mavericks' 125-122 win over the Indiana Pacers.

news.title: Flagg has 43 points, 10 rebounds, Irving 35 points in Mavericks' 125-122 win over Pacers
news.text: — Cooper Flagg had 43 points and 10 rebounds and Kyrie Irving scored 35 while completing a back-to-back for the first time this season as the Dallas Mavericks rallied past the Indiana Pacers 125-122 on Monday night.

news.title: Cooper Flagg has 25 points, career-best 12 assists as Mavericks beat Nets 130-93
news.text: — Cooper Flagg had 25 points and a career-high 12 assists for his third consecutive double-double and fourth of the season as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Brooklyn Nets 130-93 on Sunday night.

news.title: Cooper Flagg and Kyrie Irving rebound from sluggish 1st half to help Mavs beat Jazz 112-100
news.text: — Cooper Flagg scored 21 points and Kyrie Irving added 14 after a sluggish first half for both stars as the Dallas Mavericks beat the Utah Jazz 112-100 in an NBA Cup game Friday night.
